title: Browse, where a newcomer finds the neighbourhood

criteria.text: Browse is its own surface at `/explore`, own tab; not merged with Home
criteria.note: Nav tab Explore (`BottomNav.tsx`), `/` redirects to `/explore` (`src/app/page.tsx`, Home paused, #138) [V]. Checked: unmarked `BottomNav.test.tsx` ('renders exactly two tabs: Explore, You'); nothing asserts Home is not merged in (#589) [V]. Reviewed no: #138 and #308 carry no `Reviewed by:`. Shipped: deploy-health green on 3d7b5974 and 78cdefbd [V]. Smoked: smoke-live scheduled run 41093000135 on main 09ffba30 (2026-10-30) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas, after every merge here (runs 10-24 to 10-29 green too); it loads the route, it does not tap [V]. PM looked: #519 J10 ('Explore is its own screen') unticked [V].

criteria.text: Pages and posts together, complete, nothing withheld that the reader may see
criteria.note: Built half [V]: since #881 (Don, 2026-10-16 on #796) the default view mixes Pages, posts and followed updates, with a megaphone or page icon on each card (#877) and never more than two of a category in a row (#902). Missing: completeness. The whole-area read is still capped at `BROWSE_LIMIT = 100` with no paging, Pages and posts sharing the slots (`load.ts:71`), and the default read is the nearest ring that holds about 24 things on this week, widened by 'Show more nearby' (Don, 2026-10-18 [for now, beta]); #1086 (2026-10-26, migration 20261026120000) keeps the winning ring's rows from the loop instead of running it twice, same rows, same limit of 100 [V]. Open #828 (the cap); check in #589.

criteria.text: Order is locality and recency; never payment, size, follower count or what keeps you scrolling
criteria.note: `browse_feed` orders by recency inside the scope; the scope is the nearest reach ring from the member's home town (#932; Don, 2026-10-18, locality first), and since #1086 `browse_nearby` keeps the ring that met the target instead of re-running it, same order [V]; `session-shuffle.ts` reshuffles only inside recency bands; `mixRuns` (#902) breaks runs of one category and moves no dated post; searching orders by text rank (#924) [V]. Hood, town and adjacency order is F104, not built (#697). No guard scans for payment, size, follower count or engagement columns (#590). Under review (2026-10-12, [for now], Find only): the 'doesn't favour a member because of payment' clause. Reviewed no (#161 no line; #558, #815, #902, #1086 review-skipped; #932 reviewed). Shipped: green on 56404a51, f7782d6f, 24891b70, b7766901, 17734c4a, f8578fbb, eafc0e71 [V]. Smoked: smoke-live scheduled run 41093000135 on main 09ffba30 (2026-10-30) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas, after every merge here (runs 10-24 to 10-29 green too); it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: Curated lenses (today, local food, household, art, free, newly opened Pages), each a way to change what is discoverable
criteria.note: Built half [V]: the 'What's new since you were here' first look (#800 `lead.ts`), the 'What's happening' rows (F091, in the posts-only view), and since #881 a Category group (the 12 interest tags) and My interests (#911) inside the filter sheet, which Don's 2026-10-16 ruling made opt-in filters, not lens rows. Missing: local food, household and art as shown rows; the newcomers lens is only part of the first look and has no thin-row rule. The free lens: the 2026-10-25 ruling in the scenario makes 'free' a tag and the free-things lens the tag lens pointed at that word, so #832 (needs-pm) is answered and nothing waits on a price model [V scenario Rulings]. Open #587.

criteria.text: No exhaustive kind picker; typed search stays a separate job
criteria.note: No pill or chip row on Browse: `BrowseSurface.tsx` renders the search row, the reach line and cards; search is the box, server-side over the whole market (#924) [V]. Don's 2026-10-16 ruling on #796 put a Type group and a Category group inside the F092 panel (#881); read here as the panel F092 permits, not the results-surface kind picker the 2026-09-17 ruling refused [A]. `tests/no-chips.test.ts` (#956) keeps chip and pill shapes out but does not scan for a kind picker; no guard for this clause (#590) [V]. Reviewed no (#174 has no `Reviewed by:`; #881 reviewed). Shipped: green on 9dde664f, 3da54545. criteria.text: Under 1024px a floating Map/List pill at bottom centre, visible while scrolling
criteria.note: As written, not built: #479 (Don's #328) put one expanding control at the bottom right (`ExploreDock.tsx`: search, filter, area, List/Map), and #956 made it a rounded-rectangle bar under Don's 2026-10-18 [always] no-chips rule, noting 'newer wins' over the word pill [V]. The scenario's 2026-10-01 ruling still says a pill at bottom centre; neither #328 nor the no-chips rule is a dated line in its Rulings. Routed to `scope-scenario`; nothing built or filed until it is ruled. The dock is covered by `BrowseSurface.layout.test.tsx` (#328 block) and `ExploreDock.test.tsx`, unmarked.

criteria.text: Results scope to the vantage's market (home market by default, a typed place for the session); nobody picks a market, none is picked from IP
criteria.note: Restated 2026-10-11 (F104, F105). Not built [V]: scope is still a metro chosen by `?metro=`, the area picker, the device cookie or the member's default; since #1025 (2026-10-24, bug #978) the metro list is read once anonymously and cached for 5 minutes and the scope is picked from it by `pickFeedMetro` (`feed-metro.ts:120-130`) with the same precedence, requested slug, then member metro, then `DEFAULT_METRO_SLUG` (Sacramento), so a visitor with nothing still gets one picked [V]. #1038 (2026-10-24, F103.4) dropped the MSA from neighbourhood search and the outlines and says 'area' everywhere a visitor reads; the market model is unchanged. No typed place, no waiting-market absence. Open #696 (market scoping) and #698 (place control), both `deferred` to the fortnight after beta; #588 (no-metro visitor) is answered by F105 criterion 5 and is stale.

criteria.text: The place control moves a signed-in member's results, not only a signed-out visitor's
criteria.note: Restated 2026-10-11 (F105 place control). Built half [V]: the area picker and a neighbourhood search (#479, #476) move a member's results and save the pick as their default; since #1038 the neighbourhood search takes the query alone (`searchAreasAction(query)`, no metro, no MSA filter); the reach line and the sheet's How far group (#932) move how far they reach. Missing: the place control that takes any typed town, county or market, as session state only; F105 replaces the saved default. Open #698.
